perplexity.description:
20th Century Paddy (The Songs of Shane MacGowan) is a wide-ranging tribute compilation celebrating the songwriting legacy of Shane MacGowan, assembled by Rubyworks with performances from established artists, contemporary Irish acts, and international admirers. The collection draws heavily on The Pogues’ repertoire, pairing songs such as “A Rainy Night in Soho,” “Fairytale of New York,” “The Body of an American,” “Streams of Whiskey,” and “If I Should Fall From Grace With God” with interpretations by Bruce Springsteen, Hozier, Dropkick Murphys, The High Kings, and Steve Earle. MacGowan’s work appears in its original context as well, with The Pogues’ “Gabrielle” included alongside the covers.

The compilation’s appeal lies in the breadth of its musical perspectives: folk, punk, traditional Irish music, rock, and pop all meet in songs marked by MacGowan’s distinctive combination of romance, historical memory, defiance, and hard-lived storytelling. Contributions from U2, Primal Scream, The Jesus and Mary Chain, David Gray, Glen Hansard, Moya Brennan, The Libertines, The Murder Capital, and others emphasize how far his influence extends beyond Celtic punk. As both a celebration and a generational reassessment, the set presents MacGowan’s songs as enduring modern folk standards rather than artifacts of a single scene.
